name: Cashonize built-in contracts
description: Protocols the wallet finds out of the box. A bundle a user adds has this same shape, so these double as the worked examples to copy from.

contracts.name: Badgers.cash stake
contracts.description: BCH locked to mint BadgerCoins, released once the lock has aged past its length. Every user's lock sits at one contract address with the owner written into its NFT.

contracts.name: hodl lock
contracts.description: BCH locked until a block height or timestamp. The funding transaction announces the contract's address and locktime but names no owner, so ownership is proved by rebuilding the contract from the wallet's own keys.
